title: Restore a SQL Server database
description: Restore a SQL Server database from a .bak backup file.

parameters.name: databaseName
parameters.label: Database name
parameters.description: Name of the database to restore

examples.description: Restore MyDB, overwriting the existing database

examples.command: Invoke-Sqlcmd -Query "RESTORE DATABASE [MyDB] FROM DISK='C:\Backups\MyDB.bak' WITH REPLACE"

examples.description: Example using the 'databaseName' parameter: Name of the database to restore. Replace ProductionDB with the value that fits your environment.

notes: DANGER: -ReplaceDatabase overwrites the existing database! Close every connection before the restore. The SQL Server account must have access to the .bak file.
